description: Two more small query languages, judged the same way SQL is: composition is what separates a value being searched FOR from a filter the caller wrote. The bound route passes the caller's text whole as the filter argument and is silent. Unlike SQL, where a value passed whole is genuinely a parameter, an LDAP filter argument passed whole IS the filter: the requirement that keeps this rule precise on the common shape costs a real miss on that one, and the fixture records it rather than claiming the line is safe.

expected.note: the caller's text is built into the filter
the caller's text is built into the expression
